cohort: The study included 10,735 mothers aged 12-44 years with deliveries between 2009 and 2013 from the AOK Hessen database, with 2147 (20%) experiencing PTL/PTB.
finding: The greatest direct medical costs and resource use for PTL/PTB mothers were noted prior to delivery, and costs appeared to decrease with increasing gestational age, particularly during delivery hospitalization and the first year after delivery.
birth_weight: Birthweight < 2500 g was used as one of the criteria to define PTL/PTB mothers.
gest_age: Delivery of an infant < 37 weeks gestational age was used as one of the criteria to define PTL/PTB mothers, and costs were analyzed according to gestational age at delivery.
